SELECT s.admfname1, s.admlname1 FROM schools s JOIN satscores sat ON s.cdscode = sat.cds ORDER BY sat.numge1500 DESC LIMIT 1

WITH merged_unified AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.doc = '54'
      AND s.statustype = 'Merged'
      AND s.cdscode LIKE '30%'
),
merged_elementary AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.doc = '52'
      AND s.statustype = 'Merged'
      AND s.cdscode LIKE '30%'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN me.cnt = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE mu.cnt::float / me.cnt 
    END AS ratio
FROM merged_unified mu, merged_elementary me
SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode WHERE s.edopscode = 'SSS' AND s.City = 'Fremont' AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
SELECT s."gsserved", f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode WHERE s."gsserved" = 'K-9' AND f."County Code" = '19'

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM foreign_data fd
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE power = '*'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN bordercolor = 'borderless' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(id) AS percentage FROM cards

SELECT DISTINCT fd.type FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.language = 'German' AND fd.type IS NOT NULL

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.hascontentwarning = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM legalities l JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'legal'
SELECT name FROM cards WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper') ORDER BY convertedmanacost DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT s.isforeignonly FROM cards c JOIN sets s ON c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie'
SELECT fd.flavortext FROM foreign_data fd JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND fd.language = 'Italian'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ownerdisplayname = 'csgillespie'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN u.age > 65 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.owneruserid = u.id WHERE p.score > 5

SELECT DISTINCT u.id
FROM users u
JOIN posthistory ph ON u.id = ph.userid
JOIN posts p ON ph.postid = p.id
WHERE p.viewcount >= 1000
GROUP BY u.id, ph.postid
HAVING COUNT(ph.id) = 1
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) = 2010 THEN id END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) = 2011 THEN id END), 0) AS ratio FROM votes;
SELECT u.displayname FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.userid = u.id WHERE b.name = 'Autobiographer' ORDER BY b.date ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT c.text FROM comments c JOIN posts p ON c.postid = p.id WHERE p.viewcount BETWEEN 100 AND 150 ORDER BY c.score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT LEFT(date, 4) AS year FROM yearmonth ORDER BY consumption DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN czk_count > eur_count THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS more_smes_in_czk, ABS(czk_count - eur_count) AS difference FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'CZK') AS czk_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE currency = 'EUR') AS eur_count FROM customers) sub

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.a11 > 6000 AND d.a11 < 10000

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM a.date) = 1993
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT d.a2 FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

WITH target_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE a3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(a4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM client c
JOIN target_district td ON c.district_id = td.district_id
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM loan l WHERE l.amount < 100000

WITH avg_amount AS (
    SELECT AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amt
    FROM trans t
    JOIN card c ON t.account_id = (SELECT d.account_id FROM disp d WHERE d.disp_id = c.disp_id)
    WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 1998
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
FROM trans t
JOIN card c ON t.account_id = (SELECT d2.account_id FROM disp d2 WHERE d2.disp_id = c.disp_id)
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
CROSS JOIN avg_amount
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.date) = 1998
  AND t.amount < avg_amount.avg_amt;
SELECT t.* FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
SELECT a.frequency, o.k_symbol FROM account a JOIN "order" o ON a.account_id = o.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND o.amount = 3539
SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total_amount_budgeted FROM budget WHERE link_to_event = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_amount_budgeted ASC
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'
SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description FROM expense e WHERE e.link_to_member = 'Sacha Harrison'
SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone FROM member m JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)
